gram.d: 沒電了 = out of power (battery or blackout). Pair with 快: 快沒電了 = running out soon. The pattern works for anything draining: 快沒時間了, 快沒錢了 — life on low-bar alerts.

gram.d: 有時候 A 有時候 B = sometimes A, sometimes B: 有時候有訊號有時候沒有 — the signal grammar of tunnels and mountains. Also: 時A時B in news: 時好時壞 hit-or-miss.

gram.d: V + 得 + 到 = can manage to V: 聽得到 can hear, 看得到 can see. V + 不 + 到 = can't: 看不到你 can't see you. Video-call ritual and the backbone of ability grammar.

gram.d: 往往 = often, tends to (pattern-based): 人的弱點往往比系統漏洞更難防 — the human factor tends to be harder to defend. More analytical than 常常; news and reports love it.

dict.py: Wǒ de shǒujī kuài méidiàn le!

Your phone is ringing.
I'll pick up in a bit.

dict.zh: 對不起，我剛才在講電話。
dict.py: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiǎng diànhuà.
dict.en: Sorry, I was just on a call.
Hang up — I'll call back in a minute.

Bad reception — I'll call back later.
Try turning it off and on again.

dict.py: Nǐ xiànzài tīng de dào wǒ ma?

pass.zh: 我們這裡在山區，收訊很不穩定。如果電話突然斷掉，請不要擔心，我關機再開機就好。你們那邊訊號還好嗎？

What's the plan if the call drops?

dict.py: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yíge diànhuà fāng'àn.

Unlimited is 599 a month.

dict.py: Bāngyuē liǎng nián sòng xīn shǒujī.

Prepaid SIM — once it's gone, it's gone.

dict.zh: 你的方案什麼時候到期？
dict.py: Nǐ de fāng'àn shénme shíhòu dàoqī?
dict.en: When does your plan expire?

pass.zh: 您好，我們現在有吃到飽方案，月租五九九，網速最快，綁約兩年還免費送旗艦機。如果不想綁約，預付卡三九九，20GB用完就降速。請問您比較需要哪一種？

What happens when the prepaid 20GB runs out?
What's the two-year contract bonus?

dict.py: Huàmiàn kǎ zhù le, qǐng děng yíxià.

dict.py: Nǐ tīng de dào wǒ ma?

dict.py: Tīng de dào, kěshì kàn bú dào nǐ.

I'm reconnecting — one moment.

dict.py: Xiànzài huàmiàn gēn shēngyīn dōu qīngchǔ le.
dict.en: Screen and audio are both clear now.

pass.zh: Eric，視訊會議進行很順利，只有開頭的連線問題。董事長對提案很感興趣，特別是共同訓練的部分。然後他提出一個要求：簽約那天想安排展示飛行，讓他的團隊看看。你這週要準備展示計畫，週五前給我。

Large amounts of personal data were leaked.
The defense measures had gaps.

pass.zh: 資安新聞：一家科技公司遭駭客入侵，百萬筆個資外洩。調查指出，攻擊者透過社會工程騙取員工帳密，而非破解系統。主管機關要求七十二小時內通報，並限期強化防護機制。專家指出，科技再好，沒有安全意識的員工就是最大的漏洞。

scenarios.intro: Your phone actually rings this time. Keep it short, explain the busy week, and promise the Sunday call.

them.zh: 喂，寶貝！終於接了！
them.py: Wèi, bǎobèi! Zhōngyú jiē le!
them.en: Hello sweetie! You finally picked up!

turns.task: Apologize — your phone was almost dead and you missed the calls.

ans.zh: 媽！對不起，我的手機快沒電了，沒看到你打來！
ans.py: Mā! Duìbuqǐ, wǒ de shǒujī kuài méidiàn le, méi kàndào nǐ dǎ lái!
ans.en: Mom! Sorry — my phone was nearly dead, I missed your calls!

them.zh: 哎呀，要記得充電！你最近在忙什麼？
them.py: Āiyā, yào jìdé chōngdiàn! Nǐ zuìjìn zài máng shénme?
them.en: Aiya, remember to charge it! What have you been up to?

turns.task: Big news — next month signing a contract in Kaohsiung, it's a busy week!

ans.zh: 下個月要去高雄簽約，這星期超忙！
ans.py: Xià ge yuè yào qù Gāoxióng qiānyuē, zhè xīngqí chāo máng!
ans.en: Signing a contract in Kaohsiung next month — crazy busy week!

them.zh: 那麼厲害！你有好好吃飯嗎？
them.py: Nàme lìhài! Nǐ yǒu hǎohǎo chīfàn ma?
them.en: Impressive! Are you eating properly?

turns.task: Reassure her: eating well — tell her not to worry.

ans.zh: 有，我吃得很好，妳放心！
ans.py: Yǒu, wǒ chī de hěn hǎo, nǐ fàngxīn!
ans.en: Yes, eating great — don't worry!

them.zh: 好。那星期天視訊喔！
them.py: Hǎo. Nà xīngqí tiān shìxùn o!
them.en: Good. Video call Sunday!

turns.task: Confirm: Sunday for sure — love you, gotta go!

ans.zh: 好，星期天見！愛你，我先去忙了！
ans.py: Hǎo, xīngqí tiān jiàn! Ài nǐ, wǒ xiān qù máng le!
ans.en: Deal — Sunday! Love you, back to it!

them.zh: 愛你！去忙吧，掰掰！
them.py: Ài nǐ! Qù máng ba, bāibāi!
them.en: Love you! Go work — bye!

turns.task: Bye mom!

ans.zh: 掰掰！
ans.py: Bāibāi!
ans.en: Bye!

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: Two hours before the video call and your connection keeps dropping. Xiao Chen knows the tricks.

them.zh: 你臉色很差欸，怎麼了？
them.py: Nǐ liǎnsè hěn chà éi, zěnme le?
them.en: You look stressed — what's up?

turns.task: Explain: your signal keeps jumping — can't get stable connection for the 2 p.m. call.

ans.zh: 我的訊號一直跑，兩點的視訊收訊不穩，怎麼辦？
ans.py: Wǒ de xùnhào yìzhí pǎo, liǎng diǎn de shìxùn shōuxùn bù wěn, zěnme bàn?
ans.en: My signal keeps bouncing — I can't get a stable connection for the 2 p.m. call.

them.zh: 先關機再開機，很多時候就好了。
them.py: Xiān guānjī zài kāijī, hěnduō shíhòu jiù hǎo le.
them.en: Power off, power on — fixes it most of the time.

turns.task: Try it — and it works! Signal's back.

ans.zh: 試了，有效！訊號回來了！
ans.py: Shì le, yǒuxiào! Xùnhào huílái le!
ans.en: Tried it — works! Signal's back!

them.zh: 哈！要在靠窗的地方視訊，不要在牆邊。
them.py: Hā! Yào zài kào chuāng de dìfāng shìxùn, búyào zài qiáng biān.
them.en: Ha! Video call by a window, not near walls.

turns.task: Good tip — near the window it is; ask what to do if it still drops mid-call.

ans.zh: 好主意！那萬一視訊中途斷線怎麼辦？
ans.py: Hǎo zhúyì! Nà wànyī shìxùn zhōngtú duànxiàn zěnme bàn?
ans.en: Smart! And if it drops mid-call?

them.zh: 就說「不好意思，請等我一下，我重新連線」，重連就好。
them.py: Jiù shuō 'bù hǎoyìsi, qǐng děng wǒ yíxià, wǒ chóngxīn liánxiàn', chóng lián jiù hǎo.
them.en: Just say 'Sorry, one moment — I'm reconnecting.' Then reconnect.

turns.task: Memorize the line — repeat it back for practice.

ans.zh: 「不好意思，請等我一下，我重新連線。」記住了！
ans.py: 'Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐng děng wǒ yíxià, wǒ chóngxīn liánxiàn.' Jìzhù le!
ans.en: 'Sorry, one moment — I'm reconnecting.' Got it!

them.zh: 你準備好了，加油！
them.py: Nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le, jiāyóu!
them.en: You're ready — go get 'em!

turns.task: Thank him — couldn't do this without my MVP teammate.

ans.zh: 謝謝神隊友！沒有你我就糟了！
ans.py: Xièxie shénduìyǒu! Méiyǒu nǐ wǒ jiù zāo le!
ans.en: Thanks, MVP teammate! I'd be lost without you!

scenarios.intro: Your plan expires Friday. The unlimited-plus-free-phone deal is tempting — but two years is two years. Negotiate your way through.

them.zh: 您好！今天要辦什麼？
them.py: Nín hǎo! Jīntiān yào bàn shénme?
them.en: Hello! What can I help you with?

turns.task: Say your plan is expiring — you want to look at the unlimited options.

ans.zh: 你好，我的方案快到期了，想看看吃到飽的方案。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ de fāng'àn kuài dàoqī le, xiǎng kànkan chīdàobǎo de fāng'àn.
ans.en: Hi — my plan's expiring soon. I'd like to look at unlimited options.

them.zh: 我們最熱門的是月租五九九吃到飽，綁約兩年送旗艦機！
them.py: Wǒmen zuì rèmén de shì yuèzū wǔjiǔjiǔ chīdàobǎo, bāngyuē liǎng nián sòng qíjiànjī!
them.en: Our most popular: 599/month unlimited, two-year contract includes a free flagship phone!

turns.task: 599 sounds okay, but two years is long — ask if there's a shorter contract option.

ans.zh: 五九九還好，可是綁約兩年有點長，有沒有比較短的？
ans.py: Wǔjiǔjiǔ háihǎo, kěshì bāngyuē liǎng nián yǒudiǎn cháng, yǒu méiyǒu bǐjiào duǎn de?
ans.en: 599's okay, but two years is long — any shorter contracts?

them.zh: 一年的話，月租六九九，不過不送手機。
them.py: Yì nián dehuà, yuèzū liùjiǔjiǔ, búguò bú sòng shǒujī.
them.en: One year is 699/month, but no free phone.

turns.task: Do the math aloud: two years at 599 saves more — and you do need a new phone. Take the two-year deal.

ans.zh: 算一下……兩年五九九比較划算，而且我正好需要換手機。好，我選兩年的！
ans.py: Suàn yíxià...... liǎng nián wǔjiǔjiǔ bǐjiào huásuàn, érqiě wǒ zhènghǎo xūyào huàn shǒujī. Hǎo, wǒ xuǎn liǎng nián de!
ans.en: Let me think… two years at 599 is better value — and I do need a new phone. Two-year deal!

them.zh: 好的！帶證件辦手續，還要蓋章喔！
them.py: Hǎo de! Dài zhèngjiàn bàn shǒuxù, hái yào gài zhāng o!
them.en: Great! Bring your ID for the paperwork — and you'll need your chop!

turns.task: Of course — chop again! Taiwan life. You'll be back with everything.

ans.zh: 又是印章！台灣什麼都要蓋章，哈哈。我帶好再來！
ans.py: Yòu shì yìnzhāng! Táiwān shénme dōu yào gài zhāng, hāhā. Wǒ dài hǎo zài lái!
ans.en: The chop again! Taiwan needs a stamp for everything, haha. I'll be back with everything.

them.zh: 哈哈！歡迎隨時回來！
them.py: Hāhā! Huānyíng suíshí huílái!
them.en: Haha! Come back anytime!

turns.task: See you soon — and ask them to hold that phone for you.

ans.zh: 好，麻煩幫我留著那隻手機，我等一下回來！
ans.py: Hǎo, máfán bāng wǒ liúzhe nà zhī shǒujī, wǒ děng yíxià huílái!
ans.en: Please hold that phone for me — I'll be right back!

scenarios.intro: The call freezes, reconnects, and then the chairman drops a new ask: a demo flight on signing day. Handle the tech gracefully, then own the request.

them.zh: （畫面卡頓）Eric，你聽得到嗎？
them.py: (Huàmiàn kǎdùn) Eric, nǐ tīng de dào ma?
them.en: (Screen freezes) Eric, can you hear me?

turns.task: You can hear him but can't see him — say so and apologize; you're reconnecting.

ans.zh: 聽得到！可是看不到畫面，不好意思，請等我一下，我重新連線。
ans.py: Tīng de dào! Kěshì kàn bú dào huàmiàn, bù hǎoyìsi, qǐng děng wǒ yíxià, wǒ chóngxīn liánxiàn.
ans.en: I can hear you! But the screen is frozen — sorry, one moment, I'm reconnecting.

turns.keys: 聽得到看不到重新連線

them.zh: （重連後）好了！現在清楚多了。你的提案我看了，很完整。
them.py: (Chóng lián hòu) Hǎo le! Xiànzài qīngchǔ duō le. Nǐ de tí'àn wǒ kàn le, hěn wánzhěng.
them.en: (After reconnect) Good! Much clearer now. I've read your proposal — very thorough.

turns.task: Thank him — ask if there are any questions about the three parts.

ans.zh: 謝謝您！三個部分有沒有什麼問題？
ans.py: Xièxie nín! Sān ge bùfèn yǒu méiyǒu shénme wèntí?
ans.en: Thank you! Any questions on the three parts?

them.zh: 大致上沒有。我有一個新的想法：簽約當天，能不能讓我的團隊看一次展示飛行？
them.py: Dàzhìshàng méiyǒu. Wǒ yǒu yíge xīn de xiǎngfǎ: qiānyuē dàngtiān, néng bù néng ràng wǒ de tuánduì kàn yícì zhǎnshì fēixíng?
them.en: No major issues. I have a new thought: on signing day, could our team see a demonstration flight?

turns.task: Welcome it enthusiastically — a demo is a great idea; confirm you'll prepare a plan by Friday.

ans.zh: 太好了！展示飛行是個好主意，讓您的團隊親眼看到。我這週五以前把展示計畫給您。
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Zhǎnshì fēixíng shì ge hǎo zhúyì, ràng nín de tuánduì qīnyǎn kàndào. Wǒ zhè xīngqí wǔ yǐqián bǎ zhǎnshì jìhuà gěi nín.
ans.en: Wonderful — a demo flight is an excellent idea, so your team can see it firsthand. I'll send you the plan by this Friday.

them.zh: 很好。地點有什麼建議嗎？
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Dìdiǎn yǒu shénme jiànyì ma?
them.en: Good. Any suggestions on location?

turns.task: Suggest near their facility for convenience — but you'll confirm the airspace and get back to him in the plan.

ans.zh: 建議在您工廠附近，方便您的團隊。空域的部分我確認好再在計畫裡說明。
ans.py: Jiànyì zài nín gōngchǎng fùjìn, fāngbiàn nín de tuánduì. Kōngyù de bùfèn wǒ quèrèn hǎo zài zài jìhuà lǐ shuōmíng.
ans.en: Near your facility, for your team's convenience. I'll confirm airspace and explain in the plan.

them.zh: 好，期待週五的計畫！下個月見！
them.py: Hǎo, qīdài xīngqí wǔ de jìhuà! Xià ge yuè jiàn!
them.en: Good — looking forward to Friday's plan! See you next month!

turns.task: Sign off with conviction: plan on Friday, signature next month!

ans.zh: 週五計畫準時到，下個月簽約見！
ans.py: Xīngqí wǔ jìhuà zhǔnshí dào, xià ge yuè qiānyuē jiàn!
ans.en: Plan on time Friday — see you at the signing!

scenarios.zh: 訪談：無人機的資安風險
scenarios.intro: OPI drill: drone attack surfaces, the human weak link, and why trust in UxS is a security question, not just a sales one.

them.zh: 無人機也有資安的問題嗎？
them.py: Wúrénjī yě yǒu zīān de wèntí ma?
them.en: Do drones have cybersecurity risks too?

turns.task: Yes — three layers: the control link, the data, and the operator; all three can be exploited.

ans.zh: 有，而且有三個層面：控制訊號、傳輸的資料，還有操作人員——三個都可能被利用。
ans.py: Yǒu, érqiě yǒu sān ge céngmiàn: kòngzhì xùnhào, chuánshū de zīliào, háiyǒu cāozuò rényuán — sān ge dōu kěnéng bèi lìyòng.
ans.en: Yes — three layers: the control signal, the transmitted data, and the operator — all three can be exploited.

turns.keys: 控制訊號資料操作人員

them.zh: 人的問題最難防嗎？
them.py: Rén de wèntí zuì nán fáng ma?
them.en: Is the human problem the hardest to defend?

turns.task: Agree — social engineering beats system security every time; a trained pilot who clicks a phishing link is the attack vector no firewall stops.

ans.zh: 往往是。社會工程攻擊打的是人，不是系統。防火牆再好，受過訓練的飛手點了釣魚信件，攻擊就進來了。
ans.py: Wǎngwǎng shì. Shèhuì gōngchéng gōngjī dǎ de shì rén, bú shì xìtǒng. Fánghuǒqiáng zài hǎo, shòu guò xùnliàn de fēishǒu diǎn le diàoyú xìnjiàn, gōngjī jiù jìnlái le.
ans.en: Often yes. Social engineering attacks people, not systems. The best firewall doesn't stop a trained pilot who clicks a phishing link.

them.zh: 那廠商要怎麼做？
them.py: Nà chǎngshāng yào zěnme zuò?
them.en: So what should vendors do?

turns.task: Three things: encrypt the control link, minimize data stored on the drone, and train operators on security awareness — same as your contract promises, actually.

ans.zh: 三件事：把控制連線加密、盡量減少無人機上儲存的資料，還有對操作人員做資安意識訓練——這也是我們在合約裡承諾的內容。
ans.py: Sān jiàn shì: bǎ kòngzhì liánxiàn jiāmì, jǐnliàng jiǎnshǎo wúrénjī shàng chǔcún de zīliào, háiyǒu duì cāozuò rényuán zuò zīān yìshí xùnliàn — zhè yě shì wǒmen zài héyuē lǐ chéngnuò de nèiróng.
ans.en: Three things: encrypt the control link, minimize data stored on the drone, and train operators on security awareness — which is also what we promised in the contract.

them.zh: 個資外洩的新聞很多，無人機用戶要擔心嗎？
them.py: Gèzī wàixiè de xīnwén hěnduō, wúrénjī yònghù yào dānxīn ma?
them.en: Data breach news is everywhere — should drone users worry?

turns.task: Yes but proportionally: commercial drones are targets for industrial espionage, not just hackers fishing for credit cards; the risk profile is higher than a phone.

ans.zh: 要，但是要對應等級的擔心。商用無人機的目標是產業間諜，不只是偷信用卡號碼的駭客；它的風險等級比手機高。
ans.py: Yào, dànshì yào duìyìng děngjí de dānxīn. Shāngyòng wúrénjī de mùbiāo shì chǎnyè jiàntié, bù zhǐshì tōu xìnyòngkǎ hàomǎ de hàikè; tā de fēngxiǎn děngjí bǐ shǒujī gāo.
ans.en: Yes, but proportionally. Commercial drones are targets for industrial espionage, not just credit-card hackers — the risk profile is higher than a phone.

turns.keys: 產業間諜等級比手機高

them.zh: 最後一個問題：沒有資安就沒有什麼？
them.py: Zuìhòu yíge wèntí: méiyǒu zīān jiù méiyǒu shénme?
them.en: Last question: without cybersecurity, there is no…?

turns.task: Land it: without security, there is no trust. Without trust, there's no contract. Without a contract, there's no industry.

ans.zh: 沒有資安，就沒有信任。沒有信任，就沒有合約。沒有合約，就沒有產業。
ans.py: Méiyǒu zīān, jiù méiyǒu xìnrèn. Méiyǒu xìnrèn, jiù méiyǒu héyuē. Méiyǒu héyuē, jiù méiyǒu chǎnyè.
ans.en: No security, no trust. No trust, no contract. No contract, no industry.

x: 我去接電話。
Wǒ qù jiē diànhuà.
I'll go answer the phone.
vocab.n: 接電話 answer a call, 接機 pick someone up from the airport — 接 catches and receives.

x: 她講了五分鐘就掛了。
Tā jiǎng le wǔ fēnzhōng jiù guà le.
She talked five minutes and hung up.
vocab.n: 掛電話 hang up. Also 掛 = listed, hung: 掛號 registered mail. The character that ends calls.

x: 你的手機一直在響！
Nǐ de shǒujī yìzhí zài xiǎng!
Your phone keeps ringing!
vocab.n: 鬧鐘響了 alarm rang, 鈴響 bell rings — 響 = anything making noise.

x: 我手機沒電了，借充電器。
Wǒ shǒujī méidiàn le, jiè chōngdiànqì.
My phone's dead — can I borrow a charger?
vocab.n: Context splits the meaning: 手機沒電 dead battery; 停電 power cut (the whole neighborhood kind).

x: 山上訊號很差。
Shān shàng xùnhào hěn chà.
Signal is terrible in the mountains.
vocab.n: 無線電訊號 radio signal — same word, your world and daily life. 訊號強 = strong signal; 訊號弱 = weak.

x: 這個地方收訊不好。
Zhège dìfāng shōuxùn bùhǎo.
Reception is bad here.
vocab.n: 收 = receive: 收訊 reception, 收到 received, 收件 inbox. 你那邊收訊好嗎？ — the first question of every shaky call.

x: 請重新開機試試看。
Qǐng chóngxīn kāijī shìshikàn.
Please try restarting.
vocab.n: The universal tech fix: 關機再開機. Also 開機畫面 boot screen — every device speaks this language.

x: 考試的時候請關機。
Kǎoshì de shíhòu qǐng guānjī.
Please power off for the exam.
vocab.n: Also means phone/device is off: 他的手機關機中 — his phone is switched off. The ultimate ghosting tool.

x: 短期來台灣可以用預付卡。
Duǎnqí lái Táiwān kěyǐ yòng yùfùkǎ.
Prepaid SIMs work for short stays in Taiwan.
vocab.n: 預付 = pay in advance. Airport 7-11 sells them on arrival — the traveler's first stop.

x: 這個資費方案性價比很高。
Zhège zīfèi fāng'àn xìngjiàbǐ hěn gāo.
This rate plan has great value.
vocab.n: 費 = fee/charge: 資費 telecom rate, 費用 costs, 月費 monthly fee. The billing word.

x: 綁約兩年，月租比較便宜。
Bāngyuē liǎng nián, yuèzū bǐjiào piányí.
Two-year contract — lower monthly rate.
vocab.n: 綁 = bind/tie: 綁約 contract lock, 被綁住 tied down. The consumer's love-hate relationship.

x: 吃到飽方案不限速，很划算。
Chīdàobǎo fāng'àn bú xiàn sù, hěn huásuàn.
Unlimited with no throttle — great value.
vocab.n: Originally all-you-can-eat buffet. Now: 吃到飽方案 unlimited plan, 吃到飽自助餐 buffet — Taiwan repurposed it beautifully.

x: 連線不穩定，畫面會卡。
Liánxiàn bù wěndìng, huàmiàn huì kǎ.
Unstable connection makes the screen freeze.
vocab.n: 重新連線 reconnect — video call liturgy. 斷線 is the loss; 連線 is the fix. Also C2 link in your mil-speak.

x: 視訊中途斷線了。
Shìxùn zhōngtú duànxiàn le.
The video call dropped mid-session.
vocab.n: 斷 = broken: 斷線 dropped connection, 斷電 power cut, 斷鏈 supply chain break. The bad-news prefix.

x: 我分享一下我的畫面。
Wǒ fēnxiǎng yíxià wǒ de huàmiàn.
Let me share my screen.
vocab.n: Social sharing AND screen sharing — same word. 分享畫面 screen share is in every video call's toolbar.

x: 你的畫面卡住了。
Nǐ de huàmiàn kǎ zhù le.
Your screen is frozen.
vocab.n: 畫 = image + 面 = surface: video frame, movie scene, or any visual. 畫面感 = vivid imagery — a writer's compliment.

x: 個資外洩影響百萬用戶。
Gèzī wàixiè yǐngxiǎng bǎiwàn yònghù.
The data breach affected a million users.
vocab.n: 洩 = to leak: 外洩 leak out, 洩漏 disclose. 外洩事件 = a breach incident — infosec news staple.

x: 駭客入侵了公司系統。
Hàikè rùqīn le gōngsī xìtǒng.
Hackers infiltrated the company's system.
vocab.n: Phonetic from 'hacker.' Taiwan's standard term. 白帽駭客 white-hat hacker — the good guys.

x: 請不要隨意填寫個資。
Qǐng búyào suíyì tiánxiě gèzī.
Don't fill in personal data carelessly.
vocab.n: Short for 個人資料. 個資保護法 = Personal Data Protection Act — Taiwan's GDPR equivalent.

x: 這個系統的防護措施很完整。
Zhège xìtǒng de fánghù cuòshī hěn wánzhěng.
This system's protection measures are thorough.
vocab.n: 防 defend + 護 protect: 防護機制 defense mechanism, 防護衣 protective gear. Mil and infosec use it daily.

x: 吃飯的時候不要一直滑手機。
Chīfàn de shíhòu búyào yìzhí huá shǒujī.
Don't scroll your phone during meals.
slang.n: 滑 = slide/swipe: 滑手機 scrolling. The defining physical gesture of the era, made into a verb.

x: 捷運上全部都是低頭族。
Jiéyùn shàng quánbù dōu shì dītóuzú.
The whole MRT is phone zombies.
slang.n: 低頭 = head down + 族 tribe. Taiwan-coined, spread everywhere. The -族 suffix builds demographic nouns.

x: 訊號這麼差還要開視訊，頭殼壞去！
Xùnhào zhème chà hái yào kāi shìxùn, thâu-khak-bái-khì!
Trying to video call with signal this bad — are you insane?
slang.n: Hokkien. Exasperated or amused depending on tone. 壞去 = gone bad. The Taiwanese version of '你瘋了嗎？'

x: 你在群組裡潛水多久了？
Nǐ zài qúnzǔ lǐ qiánshuǐ duōjiǔ le?
How long have you been lurking in the group?
slang.n: 潛水 = diving/submerged: reading without responding. 別潛水了，說話！ — stop lurking, say something!

x: 我有點社恐，不想接陌生電話。
Wǒ yǒudiǎn shèkǒng, bùxiǎng jiē mòshēng diànhuà.
I have a bit of social anxiety — I hate answering unknown calls.
slang.n: Short for 社交恐懼症. Mainland internet, widely used in Taiwan. The opposite: 社牛 (socially fearless, the life of the party).
